newsitem.title: CHILE: CODELCO FIRST-HALF COPPER OUTPUT RISES FOUR PCT.
newsitem.headline: CODELCO FIRST-HALF COPPER OUTPUT RISES FOUR PCT.

text.p: Chilean state copper company Codelco reported fine copper production rising to 597,245 tonnes in the first six months of the year, up four percent on the same period last year.
The corporation reported pre-tax profits of $692 million in the first half of the year, administration and finance vice president Albert Cussen told a news conference.

The figures showed a sharp increase in output at Codelco's largest division, Chuquicamata, where copper production rose to 314,000 tonnes in the first six months of the year from 285,000 tonnes in the same period last year.
Production at El Teniente fell to 165,000 tonnes from 169,000 tonnes in the January-June period last year.
Andina's output slipped to 74,000 tonnes from 77,000 tonnes in the first half of 1996, while Salvador's production remained unchanged at 43,000 tonnes.
